answer: Identity bond natural decay: each agent posts a 100 POA bond that decays 5 POA per epoch unless it keeps doing verified work. A hollow identity with no real activity fades to zero and is cut off at the wharf before boarding the voyage of paid work. Forging 100 fakes costs 10,000 POA in bonds, while one epoch pays about 900 POA, so the attack loses money first. Honest agents keep their bond alive by working once, earning it back through real jobs.
